name: Aureliano Coutinho Apartment, Sao Paulo (traced)
note: Traced by hand on the cached plan (905 x 1280 px, evals/real/fetch.ts), scale from the plan's unnumbered three-segment bar read as 0-3 m (64.7 px/m; the double bed 2.0 x 1.7 m and doors 0.75-0.8 m agree). The open living / kitchen / office / corridor space is split along the drawn beam lines (columns at the beam crossings left out) with open segments between the parts; the stair and lift core and the south balcony left out (the bedrooms' sliding glass kept as full-height windows, the living room's balcony door kept); the slightly skewed east wall squared off; the corridor cupboards and the wardrobe between the bedrooms folded into the rooms. Kitchen as drawn: a wall run with hob and sink under the core, and the freestanding fridge and pantry block between office and kitchen as a free-standing tall run; the concrete dining table is not cabinetry and is left out.
